question: How is the constant washing of the mouth characterized in relation to Brahman?
premises: Washing of the mouth is performed always.
It is described as going upward.
This upward movement is related to Brahman.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is characterized as an upward movement toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The ritual or yogic sense of mukha-prakṣālana and ūrdhva-gata is context-specific.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is an upward movement toward Brahman.
